title: nephrodium reptans
intro: Nephrodium reptans, commonly known as Lady fern, is a type of vascular plant belonging to the fern family (Dryopteridaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which help in relieving coughs, colds, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Lady fern include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic, making it useful in treating urinary tract infections and other related disorders. The bioactive constituents of Nephrodium reptans include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
